第43章 排长-《70年代开局，我靠零元购发家》

接下来一段时间，王建新的日子过得规律而充实。

每天早起，去食堂吃过早点，便到卫生室为周副团长针灸。针法跟第一次一样——肺俞、尺泽、膻中，三穴配合，留针一个小时。行针的时候，他用灵力引导药力，刺激肺脏的排异功能。周副团长每次针灸完都感觉胸口松快一些，咳嗽的次数多了，咳出来的黏痰也一天比一天清。

针灸完了，王建新就在操场边上站一会儿，看看战士们训练。士兵们跑步、练队列、练刺杀、练射击，口号声震天响，脚步声咚咚咚的。他看着那些生龙活虎的战士，心里痒痒的，也想加入进去，但他还没正式分到连队，只能先看着。

看完训练，他便回到宿舍看书学习。当看完《西医基础理论》之后，他又从空间书房里找出一些从苏联收集的俄语书籍，继续学习。俄语他已经学得差不多了，看书读报没问题，但他还想再精进一些。医学类的俄语书籍有不少，解剖学、生理学、病理学，他都翻出来看，一边看一边记笔记。

时间过得很快。

一个星期后，七天的针灸疗程结束了。最后一次针灸完，王建新对周副团长说：“首长，针灸今天就结束了。中药再喝两天，巩固一下。”

周副团长点了点头，感觉胸口从来没有这么轻松过。以前总像压了块石头，现在那块石头好像被人搬走了。

王建新回到宿舍，继续学习。

晚上，大约九点多钟，王建新正在看书，忽然听见走廊里传来急促的脚步声。紧接着，勤务兵跑到他宿舍门口，门也没敲就推开了，气喘吁吁地说：“王建新同志！快！首长剧烈咳嗽！”

王建新心里知道，见效了。

他放下书，快速跟着勤务兵出了宿舍，一路小跑上了二楼，来到周副团长的房间。

周副团长正坐在床边，弯着腰，剧烈地咳嗽。一声接一声，咳得很深，像是要把肺里的什么东西咳出来。勤务员端着一个痰盂，蹲在旁边，紧张得手都在抖。已经吐了一些黏痰，带血丝的，颜色发暗。

王建新走过去，站在周副团长背后，伸出右手，按在他的背上。他调动体内的灵力，透过手掌，温和地输入周副团长的肺部，帮助清理胸腔里的黏液。灵力像一只温柔的手，在肺叶间游走，将那些包裹着弹片的炎性分泌物一点一点地推向气管。

大约五分钟。周副团长猛地一咳，身体往前一倾，从嘴里咳出一团黑色的血块，有大拇指那么大，“啪”地落在痰盂里。

然后他长长地舒了一口气，靠在床背上，脸色从涨红慢慢恢复了正常。他抬起头，看着王建新，眼睛里全是光。

“小王同志，”周副团长的声音有点发颤，“我感觉特别舒服。胸口那口气，终于通了。”

王建新用神识检查了一下周副团长的内脏。神识穿透胸壁、肺叶，在右肺下叶原来的位置仔细扫了一遍——弹片已经不见了，肺组织没有伤口感染，周围的炎症也在消退。效果很好。

“首长，接下来你就可以适当地运动锻炼了。”王建新收回手，笑着说，“肺部的弹片已经咳出来了，就在最后咳的那一团黏痰里。”

这时，勤务兵端起痰盂，跑到外面去了。不一会，他急匆匆地跑进来，手里用两根树枝夹着一个小弹片，黑褐色的，指甲盖大小，边缘不规则的，上面还沾着血丝。

“首长！找到了！”勤务兵激动得声音都变了，“首长，你看，真的咳出来了！”

周副团长接过那两根树枝，举到眼前，仔细看了看那个弹片。他看了好一会儿，眼睛微红，嘴唇动了动，没说出话来。这个弹片在他肺里待了两年多，折磨了他两年多。今天，终于出来了。

For the next period of time, Wang Jianxin's life was regular and fulfilling.

Get up early every day, go to the cafeteria to have breakfast, and then go to the clinic to perform acupuncture on Vice President Zhou.The acupuncture method is the same as the first time - Feishu, Chize, and Tanzhong, the three points are coordinated, and the needles are left in for an hour.When performing acupuncture, he used his spiritual power to guide the power of the medicine to stimulate the lung's rejection function.After every acupuncture, Vice President Zhou feels his chest becomes looser, he coughs more often, and the sticky phlegm he coughs up becomes clearer day by day.

After the acupuncture, Wang Jianxin stood at the edge of the playground for a while and watched the soldiers train.The soldiers were running, practicing formation, practicing assassination, and shooting. The slogans were loud and the footsteps were pounding.He looked at those lively warriors and felt itchy in his heart. He also wanted to join in, but he hadn't been officially assigned to a company yet, so he could only watch first.

After watching the training, he went back to his dormitory to read and study.After reading "Basic Theory of Western Medicine", he found some Russian books collected from the Soviet Union from the space study room and continued to study.He has learned almost enough Russian and can read books and newspapers no problem, but he still wants to improve a little more.There were many Russian medical books on anatomy, physiology, and pathology. He read them all and took notes while reading them.

Time flies.

A week later, the seven-day acupuncture course ended.After the last acupuncture, Wang Jianxin said to Deputy Leader Zhou: "Chief, the acupuncture is over today. I will drink Chinese medicine for two more days to consolidate it."

Vice Captain Zhou nodded, feeling that his chest had never been so relaxed.It used to feel like a stone was being pressed down on me, but now it seems like that stone has been moved away.

Wang Jianxin returned to his dormitory and continued studying.

In the evening, around nine o'clock, Wang Jianxin was reading a book when he suddenly heard rapid footsteps coming from the corridor.Immediately afterwards, the orderly ran to the door of his dormitory, pushed it open without knocking, and said breathlessly: "Comrade Wang Jianxin! Hurry! The leader is coughing violently!"

Wang Jianxin knew in his heart that it was working.

He put down his book and quickly followed the orderly out of the dormitory, trotting up to the second floor and arriving at Deputy Commander Zhou's room.

Vice-leader Zhou was sitting on the edge of the bed, bent over and coughing violently.One after another, he coughed deeply, as if he was trying to cough something out of his lungs.The orderly was holding a spittoon and squatting next to it, his hands shaking with nervousness.I have vomited some sticky phlegm, which is bloodshot and dark in color.

Wang Jianxin walked over, stood behind Deputy Commander Zhou, stretched out his right hand and pressed it on his back.He mobilized the spiritual power in his body and gently injected it into Vice Captain Zhou's lungs through his palms to help clear the mucus in his chest.The spiritual power is like a gentle hand, wandering between the lung lobes, pushing the inflammatory secretions wrapped in shrapnel to the trachea bit by bit.

About five minutes.Deputy Captain Zhou coughed suddenly, leaned forward, and coughed up a black blood clot from his mouth, as big as a thumb, which fell into the spittoon with a "snap".

Then he breathed a long sigh of relief, leaned back on the bed, and his face slowly returned to normal from flushing.He raised his head and looked at Wang Jianxin, his eyes full of light.

"Comrade Xiao Wang," Deputy Commander Zhou's voice was trembling, "I feel very comfortable. The breath in my chest is finally relieved."

Wang Jianxin used his spiritual consciousness to examine Vice Captain Zhou's internal organs.His consciousness penetrated the chest wall and lung lobes, and carefully scanned the original position of the lower lobe of the right lung - the shrapnel was gone, there was no wound infection in the lung tissue, and the surrounding inflammation was subsided.It works great.

"Chief, you can exercise properly next." Wang Jianxin retracted his hand and said with a smile, "The shrapnel in the lungs has been coughed out, and it is in the last lump of sticky phlegm."

At this time, the orderly picked up the spittoon and ran outside.After a while, he hurried in, holding a small shrapnel between two branches in his hand. It was dark brown, about the size of a fingernail, with irregular edges and blood stains on it.

"Chief! Found it!" The orderly's voice changed with excitement, "Chief, look, I really coughed it up!"

Deputy Captain Zhou took the two branches, raised them in front of his eyes, and looked at the shrapnel carefully.He looked at it for a long time, his eyes were slightly red, his lips moved, but he said nothing.The shrapnel stayed in his lungs for more than two years and tortured him for more than two years.Today, it finally came out.
